message.content:
If you want **MSNBC live streaming free online**, the most straightforward legal option in the results is the **MS NOW app**, which lets you watch live news and listen to live audio, though the app says live video streaming is available **when signed in with your TV provider**.[6][7]

If you specifically want a **free web stream without cable login**, the search results also show third-party sites claiming to offer free 24/7 live streams of MSNBC/MS NOW in a browser, such as Live News Chat and USNewsON.[1][2] These are not official MSNBC/MS NOW sources, so availability and legitimacy can vary.[1][2]

Other official ways to watch include **YouTube TV**, which lists MSNBC in its live TV lineup and offers a free trial rather than permanent free access.[3]

- **Official app:** MS NOW app on iOS/Android, with live access tied to TV provider sign-in for video.[6][7]
- **Official live TV service:** YouTube TV free trial.[3]
- **Unofficial free browser streams:** Live News Chat, USNewsON.[1][2]

If you want, I can also help you find the **best legal free option** by device, such as phone, smart TV, or laptop.
